dct_title_s: Carte Reduite du Canal de Mozambique et des Isles de Madagascar, de France, de Bourbon, de Rodriques et autres
dct_description_sm: Includes the Islands of Madagascar, France, Bourbon (Reunion) and Rodriques. Inset: two plans of the port of Seychelles and the Island of Assumption. Sea contains numerous rhumb lines; Prime meridian through Paris.

Norwich, I., Pam Kolbe, and Jeffrey C Stone. Norwich's Maps of Africa: An Illustrated and Annotated Carto-Bibliography. 2nd ed. / rev. and edited by Jeffrey C. Stone. Norwich, Vt.: Terra Nova Press, 1997, map 0339, p. 388
David Rumsey Map Center copy 1: Norwich no. NOR 0339.
